title: PTI-v0 provider-independent score payload
description: A partial or complete long-form score payload accepted by run_pti_v0.py compute-properties. Completeness is checked against the bound request manifest; missing values are never converted to zero.

x-runtime-constraints.score_cell_id: must occur in the frozen score request manifest
x-runtime-constraints.repeat_id: must be less than that cell's frozen repeat_count and unique within score_cell_id
x-runtime-constraints.normalized_score: must also be finite; JSON NaN and infinities are rejected
x-runtime-constraints.coverage: incomplete cells remain missing and cause property NOT_COMPUTABLE when frozen coverage is not met
